thesis: Efficiency comes from choosing what computation and memory to preserve, not only increasing model size.
role: Complete the architectural comparison with recurrent alternatives and distributed training.

ideas.statement: State-space models maintain fixed-size summaries and can trade exact recall for lower memory; hybrid designs combine them with attention.
Vision transformers need more data to learn structure assumed by convolution, and large training runs combine data, tensor and pipeline parallelism.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The index card and whiteboard distinguish compressed running state from retained context.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Communication costs can leave distributed accelerators waiting.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
